Sector (as selected) Consumer tech Stage (as selected) Pre-seed Team size 4 (2 founders, 2 field agents) Founders Founder 1 Aarav Deshmukh, CEO LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/aarav-deshmukh-example Background: FMCG distribution and field operations, 8 years.
